questions.question: What is the main purpose of Monte Carlo simulations in data observability?

options.text: To assess data quality and reliability

questions.explanation: Monte Carlo simulations help assess data quality and reliability by running multiple iterations to see how data behaves under various conditions.

questions.question: Which term describes the freshness of data in a data pipeline?
